sources.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model (DTM) 1m
sources.fact: Approximately 99% of England is covered at 1 m spatial resolution; Surface objects are removed to form a bare-earth terrain model
sources.limit: Survey dates vary spatially and published RMSE is not a parcel-specific confidence interval

sources.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model (DTM) 2m
sources.fact: Approximately 99% England coverage at 2 m resolution; Bare-earth semantics match the primary terrain model
sources.limit: The 2 m layer is a sensitivity check and cannot replace the pinned 1 m metric

sources.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model (DTM) 10m
sources.fact: Official 10 m composite DTM download is available; The product remains a bare-earth terrain model
sources.limit: Ten-metre resolution is too coarse for primary sub-metre parcel measurement

sources.name: LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles
sources.fact: Time-stamped terrain archive extends through 18 April 2024; EPSG:27700 and ±15 cm RMSE are documented
sources.limit: Historical surveys cannot be mixed without explicit date, transformation and geoid checks

sources.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Surface Model (DSM) 1m
sources.fact: Official 1 m composite surface model is available; EPSG:27700 and ±15 cm RMSE are documented
sources.limit: DSM values include surface objects and must not replace the bare-earth DTM metric

sources.name: Removal of Esri Image Services and persistent WCS endpoints
sources.fact: Elevation delivery is concentrated on open WCS and WMS standards; The DTM 1 m endpoint no longer carries a year suffix
sources.limit: Endpoint policy does not prove correctness of any individual GetCoverage response

sources.name: INSPIRE Index Polygons dataset
sources.fact: Dataset contains indicative locations of registered freehold property in England and Wales; Files are divided by local authority
sources.limit: INSPIRE polygons are indicative and are not legal title plans

sources.name: INSPIRE current monthly download
sources.fact: Current dataset was published 5 July 2026; New files are published on the first Sunday of every month
sources.limit: Freshness must be revalidated after the next monthly publication

sources.name: Technical guidance for GML files
sources.fact: Source polygons are captured against British National Grid; Native CRS is EPSG:27700
sources.limit: Exact containment and raster sampling must remain in native British National Grid

sources.name: Use Land and Property Data catalogue
sources.fact: INSPIRE Index Polygons are free of charge; Licence type is Open Government Licence
sources.limit: Catalogue metadata does not prove the bytes of a specific local-authority package

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 documentation
sources.fact: Open height dataset for Great Britain; Updated annually in July
sources.limit: Landscape-scale resolution cannot validate a sub-metre parcel span

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 overview and accuracy
sources.fact: Lower-resolution digital terrain model; Buildings and trees are removed from the ground surface
sources.limit: Four-metre RMSE supports gross-outlier screening only

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 technical specification
sources.fact: Grid and contour forms share source data; Both forms are supplied in 10 km tiles
sources.limit: Specification text does not prove integrity of a particular downloaded archive

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 grid data specification
sources.fact: ASCII tiles contain 200 rows by 200 columns; Each cell is 50 m by 50 m
sources.limit: Current archive headers and raster bytes still require direct verification

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 metadata specification
sources.fact: Per-tile XML metadata follows GEMINI conventions; Metadata identifies product and spatial representation
sources.limit: Metadata cannot replace hashes of the archive and raster payload

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 source data
sources.fact: Source terrain is represented as a triangulated irregular network; Mass points and breaklines retain significant terrain features
sources.limit: Interpolation and generalisation reinforce the coarse crosscheck-only role

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 product supply
sources.fact: Online download is available without registration; The tiled national set contains 2,858 ten-kilometre tiles
sources.limit: Availability does not prove that required TQ archive bytes were obtained in this runtime

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 GML feature types
sources.fact: GML geometries express CRS as urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::27700; Height values reference Newlyn or another applicable British height datum
sources.limit: Release-specific identifiers are not stable evidence across refreshed tiles

sources.name: National Grid Transformation OSTN15
sources.fact: OSTN15 is the national transformation between ETRS89 and OSGB36; It uses a one-kilometre transformation grid
sources.limit: Display-coordinate conversion must not replace native EPSG:27700 parcel sampling

sources.name: National Geoid Model OSGM15
sources.fact: OSGM15 converts ETRS89 ellipsoid heights to orthometric heights; Mainland Britain output is directly compatible with Ordnance Datum Newlyn
sources.limit: A geoid model does not prove that source raster values were transformed correctly

sources.name: EPSG 27700 registry definition
sources.fact: Identifier resolves to OSGB36 / British National Grid; Registry classifies it as a projected CRS
sources.limit: A CRS identifier does not prove correct transformation or sampling

sources.name: Web Coverage Service standard
sources.fact: WCS provides Internet access to multidimensional coverages; Core requirements are mandatory for conformant implementations
sources.limit: Standards text does not prove that a specific endpoint returned correct parcel values

sources.name: WCS 2.0.1 executable compliance test suite
sources.fact: Suite checks GetCapabilities and DescribeCoverage access; GetCoverage KVP behaviour is tested
sources.limit: The generic suite is not evidence that the Environment Agency endpoint was certified by it

sources.name: WCS interpolation extension notice
sources.fact: Interpolation affects subsetting, scaling and CRS transformation; Positions can be affected by accuracy and rounding
sources.limit: A standards-development notice does not establish the interpolation method of a specific response

checks.name: SAFE_SYNC_NO_HARD_RESET
checks.detail: Operator recovery uses include-untracked stash, atomic fetch, ancestry check and merge --ff-only; hard reset is forbidden.

checks.name: SINGLE_RUNNER_PROCESS_GUARD
checks.detail: Restart helper blocks multiple canonical processes or daemons and never starts a second process when one is active.

checks.name: REV16_BLOB_PIN_SET
checks.detail: Verifier pins helper, operator, carrier, entrypoint, numeric gate, metric guard, Terrain50 chain and web verifier blob identities.

checks.name: EXACT_TARGET_NO_FALLBACK
checks.detail: Rows 30762, 46142 and 61522 are mandatory and nearest-row fallback remains disabled.

checks.name: PINNED_EA_COVERAGE_AND_ORDER
checks.detail: Exact EA DTM1m CoverageId is required; current height metric guard runs before Terrain50 and port8012.

checks.name: METRIC_DRIFT_FAIL_CLOSED
checks.detail: Current max-minus-min must match preserved exact results within 0.001 m; median elevation remains a distinct field.

checks.name: TERRAIN50_ACCURACY_SCREEN
checks.detail: OS RMSE 4.0 m plus EA RMSE 0.15 m preserve 4.15 m and 8.30 m conservative screens; not labelled a confidence interval.

checks.name: LOOPBACK_WEB_EXACT_BINDING
checks.detail: Web verifier requires loopback port8012, current local candidate SHA, exact row/HMLR/metric bindings and at least 1036 full-site rows.
